description: This Swift source file defines components related to locating and resolving the runtime environment, specifically focusing on Node.js runtime versions. It includes enums, structs, and a locator class with methods for finding the executable, reading its version, and handling errors.

classes.name: RuntimeLocator
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve the runtime environment, specifically for Node.js, including finding the executable and parsing its version.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to find the Node.js runtime in specified search paths, checks its version, and ensures it meets minimum requirements.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of failure reasons when runtime resolution fails.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches through provided paths to find an executable with the specified name.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Runs the binary with --version argument and reads its output to parse the version string.
